question: Which of the following five year plan of India aim was to make India a 'self-reliant' and 'self-generating' economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Third five year Plan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The aim of the **Third Five Year Plan** was to make India a **'self-reliant' and 'self-generating' economy**.
 
• The plan focused on agriculture and improving the production of wheat to ensure self-sufficiency in food grains.
